queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'QGIS %' AND publisher = 'QGIS.org' AND version NOT LIKE '3.44.%';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'QGIS %' AND publisher = 'QGIS.org' AND version NOT LIKE '3.44.%' AND version_compare(version, '4.2.2') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'qgis-bin.exe');
